title: Sr. Manager- Underwriting and Portfolio Management

cond_0001.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will take a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience
At least 5 years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
7+ Years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio, or asset management
Previous leadership (informal or formal) experience with deal teams or analysts

cond_0037.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.

You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills.
cond_0037.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0037.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience
At least 5 years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
7+ Years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio, or asset management
Previous leadership (informal or formal) experience with deal teams or analysts

cond_0130.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will take a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of credit risk and deal structuring.
cond_0130.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0130.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience
At least 5 years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
7+ Years of experience in credit underwriting or portfolio or asset management
Previous leadership (informal or formal) experience with deal teams or analysts

cond_0149.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will take a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills. Most people become stronger in this kind of credit and portfolio work over time as they build experience and learn from the deals they work on.
cond_0149.responsibilities:

Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently

At least 5 years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management

cond_0158.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo

Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns

Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently

cond_0245.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will play a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills.
cond_0245.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0245.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management.
Proven track record of leading deal teams or analysts, whether in a formal or informal leadership capacity.
Deep knowledge of credit risk management principles and practices.
Strong command of financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis.
Expertise in preparing and reviewing financial models independently.
Advanced knowledge of credit documentation, including term sheets, commitment letters, and fee letters, with the ability to negotiate terms with customers and internal stakeholders.
Exceptional communication skills and strong leadership abilities, with the capacity to guide junior team members and influence internal partners.

cond_0254.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will play a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills.
cond_0254.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0254.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management
Proven track record of leading deal teams or analysts, whether in a formal or informal leadership capacity
Preferred Requirements
Deep knowledge of credit risk management across complex or unique transactions
Substantial experience independently managing a portfolio of accounts with strong quality and reporting outcomes

cond_0271.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will take a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills.
cond_0271.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0271.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience
At least 5 years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
7+ Years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio, or asset management
Previous leadership (informal or formal) experience with deal teams or analysts

cond_0375.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization works with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will bring subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to handle responsibilities independently. Beyond your own work, you will take a leadership role across deal teams, regularly guiding and engaging with more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions and unique problems based on your experience and skills.
cond_0375.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; actively engage with industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Work closely with less experienced team members on financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis, explaining concepts and clarifying approaches
Prepare and review financial models independently
Stay in regular contact with the deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a visible leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders directly
Drive overall deal process and lead ongoing communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and walk stakeholders through areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; regularly review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in close partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and lead quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond promptly to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across functions and business lines to foster ongoing collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers on a regular basis to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Actively participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0375.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience
At least 5 years of experience in credit underwriting or at least 5 years of experience in portfolio management or at least 5 years of experience in asset management
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
7+ Years of experience in credit underwriting or portfolio or asset management
Previous leadership (informal or formal) experience with deal teams or analysts

cond_0454.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will take a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of credit risk and deal structuring.
cond_0454.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0454.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience
At least 5 years of experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
7+ Years of experience in credit underwriting or portfolio or asset management
Previous leadership (informal or formal) experience with deal teams or analysts
At this time, [Company name masked] will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.
No agencies please.

cond_0551.intro:
The Underwriting and Portfolio Management organization is responsible for working with internal partners to underwrite new transactions and manage the existing portfolio of loans. Our Underwriters and Portfolio Managers balance supporting the Commercial Bank's growth and ensuring we have a scalable, well-managed business. This role supports the Regional Commercial Bank.
As an Underwriter & Portfolio Manager III, you will demonstrate subject matter expertise in credit risk management and are expected to perform responsibilities independently. In addition to your own job duties, you will play a leadership role across deal teams by guiding and shaping more junior associates. You are trusted with the most complex transactions or solve unique problems because of your experience and job specific skills.
cond_0551.responsibilities:
Primary underwriting responsibilities may include:
Lead due diligence process and calls; evaluate industry research to draw relevant conclusions on material strengths, risks, and mitigants
Assist less experienced team members in financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis
Prepare and review financial models independently
Coordinate with deal team on appropriate structuring options or overrides to financial models
Write and prepare all parts of the credit approval memorandum; review work of less experienced members of the team; take a leadership role in conversations with internal partners
Oversee closing process requirements; prepare and review closing memo
Prepare term sheets, commitment letters and fee letters with minimal guidance; understand majority of provisions of all credit documents and can provide rationale; negotiate credit docs with customers and internal stakeholders
Drive overall deal process and lead communication with internal and external constituents; constructively improve deal process
Delegate spreading and risk ratings to analysts or contractor teams
Review pricing models independently; understand drivers for pricing model outputs and consider areas for increasing returns
Primary portfolio or asset management responsibilities may include:
Manage a portfolio of accounts independently; review and monitor portfolio accounts' health and performance against expectations; drive customer retention
Proactively anticipate issues, draw parallels from other accounts to own account; resolve problem accounts in partnership with other teams and specialists
Complete annual reviews and both material and non-material modifications independently and on time
Facilitate and leads quarterly portfolio reviews
Ensure compliance with credit policies and procedures for existing accounts
Respond to requests from all internal and external stakeholders
Ensure portfolio data is accurate, timely, and complete to ensure strong quality and reporting capabilities
Additional Responsibilities may include:
Build relationships across function and business to foster collaboration between partner groups
Interact directly with customers to cultivate strong relationships while balancing risk and return
Mentor and train rotational analysts and new hires
Participate in internal initiatives to ensure the business is well-managed and operates efficiently
cond_0551.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in credit underwriting, portfolio management, or asset management.
Proven track record of leading deal teams or analysts, whether in a formal or informal leadership capacity.
Deep knowledge of credit risk management principles and practices.
Strong command of financial statement analysis and cash flow analysis.
Expertise in preparing and reviewing financial models independently.
Advanced knowledge of credit documentation, including term sheets, commitment letters, and fee letters, with the ability to negotiate terms with customers and internal stakeholders.
Exceptional communication skills and strong leadership abilities, with the capacity to guide junior team members and influence internal partners.
